name: Roger
source:
Roger Ruvie is the manager of Wammy's House when Watari is not present. His job is to assemble talented kids and raise an heir to the L name.

[Edited from [url=http://deathnote.wikia.com/wiki/Roger_Ruvie]Death Note Wiki[/url]]
